title: Stream Peak Score Tracker
description: Design a class to find the k-th highest score in a stream of incoming integer scores. Note that it is the k-th highest score in the sorted order, not the k-th distinct element. Implement the KthScoreTracker class with a constructor that takes integer k and a score stream array, and an add method that accepts a new score and returns the current k-th highest score.
constraints: At most 10^4 calls will be made to add.
input_format: Initialization parameters (k, initial stream array) followed by add operation inputs.
output_format: Integer values representing the k-th highest score after each addition.

examples.explanation: After adding elements to the stream, the tracker continuously returns the 3rd highest element.
With k=1 and an empty initial stream, adding 5 results in 5.
Handles duplicate elements correctly according to sorted order.
